{{Quote|General… General Veers! Sir, you've got to listen to me. Hang on, all right?|Lastok|<ref name="Duty" />}}
'''Lastok''', [[Operating number|designated]] '''TK-7834''', was a [[Gender|male]] [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[AT-AT pilot]] who served in [[Blizzard Force]] during the [[Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="Duty" /> in [[3 ABY]].<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> He was the designated [[pilot]] for ''[[Blizzard 1]]'', the [[All Terrain Armored Transport|AT-AT]] of [[General]] [[Maximilian Veers]], along with the gunner [[TK-5187]]. The vehicle was taken down by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] [[snowspeeder]] flown by [[rebel pilot]] [[Derek Klivian]], that crashed into the cabin. Lastok survived the crash, and helped to find and rescue General Veers along the rubble of the AT-AT.<ref name="Duty" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Super excited to say Alex and I were given TK numbers in FACPOV ESB! Mine is my birthday 5-1-87 and Alex's is also his birthday but scrambled 3-4-87 - also named after @VeersWatch|Mollie Damon, on the naming references of Lastok and his designation|<ref name="MollieDamon">{{Twitter|MollieDamon|status/13266987684619956227|Mollie Damon|quote=Super excited to say Alex and I were given TK numbers in FACPOV ESB! Mine is my birthday 5-1-87 and Alex's is also his birthday but scrambled 3-4-87 - also named after @VeersWatch|archivefile=File:Mollie-Damon-FACPOV-references.jpg}}</ref>}}
[[File:Lastok-ESB.png|thumb|left|250px|Lastok, as he appears in ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]
The AT-AT pilot that would later be known as Lastok first appeared in the [[1980]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars:'' Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], directed by [[Irvin Kershner]]. He was played by an uncredited extra and is only seen from behind. There is a distinctive disparity in his appearance in the film as well. Early in the battle sequence, his helmet is plain white, however, later in the battle, there is a clearly visible red line down the back of the helmet.<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> Lastok was later identified, as well as his designation TK-7834, in the short story "[[The Truest Duty]]," written by [[Christie Golden]] as a part of the [[2020]] short story collection ''[[From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back]]''.<ref name="Duty" />

Lastok is a [[tuckerization]] of the last name of George Kostal, who ran the @VeersWatch Twitter account. VeersWatch was dedicated to checking out each new ''Star Wars'' content in search of potential appearances of Maximillian Veers,<ref name="VeersWatch">{{Twitter|VeersWatch|status/1326203266351460352|Veers Watch|quote=And on an even more selfish level he's saved by his pilot, Lastok, WHICH UH HAS ME PRETTY DAMN EXCITED|archivedate=20201110165530}}</ref> the focus of "The Truest Duty." The tweet announcing Veers as the story's subject even referenced the VeersWatch account, stating that the "watch has ended" with the return of Veers.<ref name="Reveal">{{Twitter|DelReyStarWars|status/1313484170606321672|[[Del Rey]]|quote=11 - And now your watch has ended. General Veers has arrived. @ChristieGolden #StarWars #FromaCertainPOVStrikesBack|archivedate=20201006173206}}</ref> Just as TK-5187's designation number is the birth date of video creator Mollie Damon of "[[Star Wars Explained]]," Lastok's designation number, 7834, is a scrambled variation of the birth date of Alex Damon of "Star Wars Explained."<ref name="MollieDamon" />
